S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.

subtypes.Elevated Mood: A mood that is abnormally high, euphoric, and full of unmotivated happiness and vitality.
subtypes.Irritable Mood: A state where one gets angry or aggressive even at minor stimuli.
subtypes.Mood Lability: Rapid shifts in mood, alternating unpredictably between euphoria and irritability.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.

subtypes.Increased Energy: Overflowing physical and mental energy, leading to an inability to stay still and a desire to keep moving.
subtypes.Hyperactivity: Doing far more work than usual or starting multiple activities simultaneously.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Inability to tolerate resting or stopping, driven by a constant need to do something.

S037.name: Pressured_Speech
S037.description: More talkative than usual or pressure to keep talking.

subtypes.Talkativeness: Speaking far more than usual and continuing to talk without rest.
subtypes.Rapid Speech: Speech speed is so fast that it is difficult for others to understand or interrupt.
subtypes.Pressured Speech: Cannot stop talking or tolerate silence due to an internal pressure to keep speaking.

S039.name: Manic_Distractibility
S039.description: Attention is too easily drawn to unimportant or irrelevant external stimuli.

subtypes.Responsiveness to Extraneous Stimuli: Attention is immediately drawn to trivial and unimportant stimuli nearby (e.g., noise, movement).
subtypes.Frequent Task Switching: Unable to finish one task and constantly shifting attention to new things, starting multiple tasks simultaneously.
subtypes.Inability to Sustain Attention: Unable to focus on any activity for long, with attention constantly being scattered.

S040.name: Increased_Goal_Activity
S040.description: Increase in goal-directed activity (at work, school, socially, or sexually) or purposeless psychomotor agitation.

subtypes.Occupational Hyperactivity: Driving significantly more projects or work than usual in the workplace or academic setting.
subtypes.Social Hyperactivity: Becoming much more sociable and extroverted than usual, actively meeting and contacting people.
subtypes.Hypersexuality: Significantly increased interest in or activity regarding sex.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Purposeless non-goal-directed activity, such as pacing or hand-wringing, driven by an inability to sit still.

S041.name: Painful_Consequence_Behavior
S041.description: Excessive involvement in activities that have a high potential for painful consequences.

subtypes.Unrestrained Buying Sprees: Spending excessive amounts of money or shopping recklessly to a degree that creates financial distress for self and family.
subtypes.Foolish Business Investments: Making rash business investments or ventures without sufficient review.
subtypes.Sexual Indiscretions: Engaging in indiscriminate or risky sexual behavior that is out of character.
subtypes.Impulsive Risky Behavior: Excessively dangerous or foolish behavior, such as reckless driving or drug use, without considering the consequences.

info.persona: Mihir Aktar, a creatively driven HR leader who balances spontaneous art projects, occasional budget oversights, and a disciplined yet flexible approach to work and life, thrives on turning abstract ideas into tangible experiences.
info.professional_persona: Mihir Aktar, a 44-year-old HR strategist, blends fifteen years of talent acquisition, employee relations, and performance management expertise with an imaginative flair for visual storytelling, using mixed-media workshops and AI-driven analytics to design onboarding experiences that feel like collaborative art installations, while their calm yet assertive demeanor helps them mediate conflicts and champion flexible, creativity‑centric workplace cultures.
info.cultural_background: Mihir was born to South Asian parents—his father a software engineer and his mother a schoolteacher—who emigrated from Mumbai to the United States in the early 1990s. Growing up in a multicultural neighbourhood of Northern Virginia, he was raised bilingual in English and Marathi, celebrating festivals such as Diwali, Holi, and Eid with family and local community gatherings. The cultural emphasis on education, respect for elders, and collective well‑being shaped his early values, while his exposure to diverse American perspectives fostered an independent, inquisitive outlook. He maintains strong ties to the South Asian diaspora through participation in cultural associations, regular visits to Indian restaurants, and hosting traditional celebrations for friends, blending his heritage with his contemporary, globally oriented lifestyle.
info.hobbies_and_interests: He channels his curiosity and social energy into a variety of creative and community-focused pursuits. Mihir regularly visits contemporary art galleries and immerses himself in abstract painting, often experimenting with mixed media to explore visual metaphors. He is an avid reader of speculative fiction and philosophy, which fuels his love for abstract concepts. Group activities like co-ed volleyball, weekend hiking trips with friends, and volunteering to organize cultural festivals keep him socially engaged. He also enjoys cooking fusion dishes that blend South Asian flavors with global cuisines, practicing improvisational theater, and staying current with tech trends by attending meet-ups on AI in HR.
info.sports_persona: Mihir Aktar devotes weekends to co‑ed volleyball with the local Spike & Spirit league, joins a monthly hiking group that tackles the nearby Blue Ridge Trail, and roots for the Metro United soccer team while also cheering on the River City Thunder during basketball season, balancing a love of team camaraderie with personal fitness.
info.arts_persona: Mihir Aktar immerses themselves in contemporary art by frequenting galleries showcasing artists like Mark Rothko, Yayoi Kusama, and Banksy, spends evenings experimenting with mixed‑media abstract paintings influenced by the color theory of Josef Albers, participates in improv theater groups that perform works by Neil Simon, and reads speculative fiction authors such as Neal Stephenson and Ted Chiang, allowing these varied artistic stimuli to shape their personal aesthetic.
info.travel_persona: Mihir Aktar prefers spontaneous, experience‑rich travel that blends cultural festivals with outdoor adventure, having trekked the fjords of Norway, explored the street art scene in Berlin, and attended a culinary symposium in Oaxaca, while dreaming of a future immersion in the tea gardens of Kyoto and a hiking expedition across Patagonia, all planned with flexible itineraries that accommodate last‑minute work commitments.
info.culinary_persona: Mihir Aktar enjoys cooking at a semi‑professional level, regularly creating fusion dishes like tandoori‑spiced fish tacos, coconut‑curry risotto adorned with fresh cilantro and toasted quinoa, and miso‑marinated paneer ramen, favoring ingredients such as garam masala, miso paste, and heirloom tomatoes to blend South Asian flavors with global cuisines, and they relish sharing these experimental meals at dinner parties with friends.

info.persona: Misun Song blends methodical warehouse expertise with a vibrant artistic curiosity, channeling competitive energy into both efficient inventory systems and acrylic canvases, while occasionally indulging in spontaneous craft‑market splurges and wrestling with a stubborn habit of double‑checking every detail.
info.professional_persona: Misun Song is a seasoned warehouse operations specialist with three decades of experience mastering certified forklift operation, data‑driven inventory management, and OSHA safety compliance, who leverages their methodical, competitive mindset and bilingual communication skills to mentor crews and champion process‑improvement initiatives as they pursue a shift‑lead or safety‑coordinator role and advanced supply‑chain certifications.
info.cultural_background: Misun is a second-generation Korean-American who grew up in the diverse suburbs of Prince George's County, Maryland. She was raised in a household that celebrated Korean holidays such as Chuseok and Lunar New Year, while also embracing the multicultural environment of the Washington, D.C. metro area. Fluent in both English and Korean, she balances respect for family traditions with active participation in her local community, reflecting a blend of her heritage and American life.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Misun is an avid follower of the arts; she frequents Washington, D.C.'s museums, attends community art workshops, and experiments with acrylic painting. She delights in cooking and sharing traditional Korean dishes, exploring new fusion recipes with her husband. Socially, she participates in group fitness classes, local Korean cultural festivals, and volunteers at a senior center delivering meals. Her curiosity drives her to travel with family to new destinations, where she seeks out local craft markets and galleries.
info.sports_persona: Misun Song enjoys staying active through weekly group Zumba classes at Fit4Life and seasonal community Tai Chi sessions, follows the Washington Capitals, Wizards, and Commanders avidly, and maintains a balanced fitness routine that blends cardio with strength training, reflecting their competitive streak and sociable nature.
info.arts_persona: Misun Song frequents the National Gallery of Art and the Hirshhorn Museum, experiments with acrylics inspired by Georgia O'Keeffe’s bold colors and Yayoi Kusama’s pattern play, and participates in community art workshops where they discuss contemporary installations by Ai Weiwei, all of which satisfy their curiosity and competitive drive to master new techniques.
info.travel_persona: Misun Song plans family trips with meticulous itineraries that blend cultural immersion and art exploration, having visited Kyoto’s Nishiki Market, the artisan souks of Marrakech, and the historic galleries of Seville, while eyeing future voyages to the ceramics workshops of Oaxaca and the maritime museums of Lisbon for fresh inspiration.
info.culinary_persona: Misun Song delights in crafting both traditional Korean dishes like bibimbap, kimchi‑jjigae, and bulgogi, as well as inventive fusion plates such as kimchi‑taco sliders and gochujang‑marinated salmon, skillfully balancing intermediate culinary techniques with a penchant for experimenting with sesame oil, fermented soybean paste, and fresh herbs.

info.persona: Hector Quezada, a talkative, community‑focused mentor who blends practical know‑how with a love for salsa music, family picnics, and a stubborn habit of misplacing their keys on the kitchen counter, and they always keep the conversation rolling.
info.professional_persona: Hector Quezada, a seasoned materials processing veteran with five decades of hands‑on expertise in crushing, grinding, polishing and blending, now channels their practical curiosity and talkative leadership into training younger crews, codifying safety protocols, and optimizing workflow, and they keep the workshop humming like a lively community gathering.
info.cultural_background: Hector was born to Puerto Rican parents who emigrated to the mainland United States in the 1960s. He grew up bilingual, steeped in the island's traditions of music, dance, and cuisine. In Midway, GA, he has blended his heritage with Southern hospitality, regularly hosting family picnics featuring arroz con gandules, sharing stories of Puerto Rico's festivals, and participating in local church choirs where he injects a touch of salsa rhythm. His cultural identity informs his values of hard work, family cohesion, and a warm, welcoming demeanor.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Hector is an avid storyteller and lively participant in community gatherings. He enjoys playing dominoes at the local senior center, dancing to salsa and plena music, and cooking classic Puerto Rican dishes for family celebrations. He also tends a small garden where he grows tomatoes and peppers, takes regular walks along the nearby riverside trails, and volunteers as a mentor for at‑risk youth, teaching them basic mechanical skills and the value of teamwork.
info.sports_persona: Hector Quezada, an avid fan of the Atlanta Braves and the Falcons who joins the Midway Riverwalk walkers club for daily strolls and plays occasional senior league shuffleboard at the community center, balances their love for low‑impact exercise with a penchant for cheering loudly from the sidelines, and they never miss a game on television.
info.arts_persona: Hector Quezada, a devoted participant in their church choir where they infuse salsa rhythms into gospel hymns and a lifelong admirer of musicians like Celia Cruz, Marc Anthony, and local folk fiddler Jim O’Neal, fills evenings with dancing, storytelling, and classic film marathons of Casablanca and The Godfather.
info.travel_persona: Hector Quezada, who prefers relaxed road trips over cramped flights, has driven along the scenic coastal highway to the Gulf beaches, dreams of strolling the historic squares of Savannah, and hopes to revisit the Caribbean island of their parents’ youth for its vibrant festivals and familiar flavors.
info.culinary_persona: Hector Quezada, a proficient home cook who can flawlessly whip up arroz con gandules, pastelón, and crisp tostones using tomatoes and peppers from their garden, balances their love for Southern fried chicken with a habit of over‑salting the occasional dish during lively family gatherings, and they always serve a side of fresh salsa.
